name: Her Red Cosmos
source:
A burnt out singer seeks solitude in her deceased grandmother's old home. Then something starts leaving her flowers.

[From [url=https://cryoslight.itch.io/her-red-cosmos]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名身心俱疲的歌手來到已故祖母的老宅，想尋個清靜。隨後，有什麼東西開始給她送花。

［摘自[url=https://cryoslight.itch.io/her-red-cosmos]itch.io[/url]］
